name: 03_recipes_and_trends
prompt: High fidelity premium Android FitnessApp UI mockup board, TWO large readable phone screens side by side, flat UI no device shells, Spanish. Continuous open charcoal #121416 backgrounds, champagne #D8C3A5, ivory #F4F0EA secondary #BCB7AE. SAME SMOKED LIQUID GLASS as selected fitness navigation: subtle translucent charcoal inputs and action pills with warm upper-rim reflections. NO enclosing giant cards, NO glossy borders around all sections, NO neon. Sections directly on background separated by typography and space. Only interactive controls have smoky glass. Cohesive accessible 48dp controls, generous but useful spacing, native Compose typography. Small board caption 'PROPUESTA · DATOS DE EJEMPLO'. All numbers are fictional UI examples, not nutrition guidance. No competitor logos, no fake verified badges. Nested Nutrition flow, back arrow instead of global bottom navigation. LEFT screen 'Mi receta', name 'Bowl de pollo y arroz', small food illustration optional, source 'Receta propia · Ejemplo'. Glass segmented modes 'Por ración' selected and 'Por 100 g'. Clear two glass fields 'Raciones · 2', 'Peso final cocinado · 600 g'. List 'Ingredientes' with three editable food ingredient rows, quantities indicated, '+ Añadir ingrediente'. Summary 'Por ración · 300 g', '450 kcal', 'P 30 g · C 55 g · G 12 g', small explanatory 'Calculado a partir de ingredientes'. Collapsible 'Preparación'. Bottom primary 'Guardar receta', secondary text 'Guardar no registra una comida'. RIGHT screen title 'Tendencias', segments '7 días', '30 días'. Small 'Datos de ejemplo'. Clean understated calorie bar chart with day labels and TWO missing days shown as gaps labeled 'Sin registros', NOT zero bars. Headline '5 días con registros', secondary 'Promedio de días registrados'. Compact metric '1.850 kcal / día registrado'. Macro summary bars below, 'Proteínas', 'Carbohidratos', 'Grasas' with readable units, no red danger labels. Small info text 'Un día sin registros no significa que no hayas comido'. Goal control 'Editar objetivos' and subtle link 'Ver diario'. No body scores, no estimated weightloss, no automated meal prescription. Preserve open background with glass only on inputs/buttons, polished professional nutrition tracker matching our fitness editor.
